svg.aria-label: Two stages. Lower voice holds C4; upper voice goes from E4 to F4. Along the path: movement words. At stage 2, C4 + F4: a perfect fourth, 5 semitones, in the perfect fourth colour. Interval words describe the pair at a single stage.
svg.title: Two kinds of words: along a path, up a stage

g.text: Movement words: what each voice does from
one stage to the next, along a path.
Interval words: the pair at one stage, C4
How to read this graphic: Follow the upper
line left to right: that horizontal direction
is movement. Then look straight up the page
at stage 2: that vertical gap, the only
coloured part, is the interval. One kind of
word is about travelling, the other about
